subject: How to debug shinyapps.io hosted app

messages.author: 4914a55a73e42325
messages.subject: How to debug shinyapps.io hosted app
parts: A colleague of mine tried to publish a shiny app to shinyapps.io. We can both run it in R studio, but we both tried to publish it to shinyapps.io and it fails to run. How are you supposed to debug an app that is hosted on shinyapps.io? If it is failing, where do you look for errors?

Stacey,

You can check the console output for your application running on shinyapps.io, buy running shinyapps::showLogs()

Hope that helps.

parts:
Awesome! After debugging, I found out that shinyapps.io uses different locale settings, so when trying to do as.Date() using a short month name in the string (such as "Jan") did not work. I used the following inline code to convert my month name from my character data source to a number (where Month is the variable that has the value of the name you want to convert to a month index): match((Month),c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"))

Hope this might help someone in the future!
